response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY cu.gender), s AS (SELECT gender, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT gender, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT gender, cnt AS order_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
